semanticMatching.reasoningEffortNote: Optional Codex reasoning effort (one of the efforts models.catalog lists for the Codex model); omit to keep the CLI default.

quotaPolicy.patternsNote: Optional regex overrides per class (fiveHourLimit, modelWeeklyLimit, accountWeeklyLimit, notQuota, genericLimit, authExpired, modelUnavailable, unknownModel); see src/engines/quota.mjs for the recorded defaults.

prescreen.note: Two-step scoring: the Prescreen stage (Settings > Task assignments; default codex / the lightest ChatGPT model / low) scores every candidate from the first 1,500 JD characters and the resume digests. The first shadowRuns nights drop nothing and report recall; enforce is set from Settings once they are done.

coverLetter.autoGenerateNote: After each run (and Run Now) letters are written for the run's new high matches, best scores first, skipping postings with a letter or an uncertain company, using the Cover letter draft and editor assignments. maxPerRun 0 means no limit. Postings a pass did not reach (a limit or a failure stopped it) are queued and written first next time. Off for a local-only config or incomplete material.

models.assignmentsNote: Cover letter draft and editor each pick an engine, model, and (Codex) effort, with a fallback chain of registry ids. Omitted stages default to codex / gpt-5.6-sol at medium (draft) and high (editor), falling back to claude-opus-5-5; a Codex step is skipped while Codex is not connected. Scoring (and Supplemental, which follows it) stays in semanticMatching; its fallback chain is quotaPolicy.modelLadder plus fallbackEngine.
models.catalogNote: The model registry: every model the hub may call, by full id. The CLI receives the id; alias is the shorthand the CLI also accepts; efforts apply to Codex models only. Omit to use the defaults in src/engines/catalog.mjs (checked against Claude Code 2.1.292 and codex-cli 0.153.0); an older hub.modelChoices list is migrated automatically.

plans.plansNote: Plans are detected from the CLIs (Claude: auth status; ChatGPT: codex login status, else the plan claim in ~/.codex/auth.json, decoded locally). manual overrides or fills in a plan; scheduledChange announces a known switch and takes effect on its local date.

preferences.locationPolicy: United States only, including remote roles that permit work from the USA
preferences.titleFamiliesNote: Title pre-screen before enrichment: ATS boards, Hacker News, and RemoteOK postings must name one of these families; curated lists and alert emails skip this check. Family terms also match common endings (engineer → engineering, developer → development, statistic → statistician); acronyms stay whole-word. prefilterExcludeTitleTerms and excludeLevelSuffixes add to excludeTitleTerms for the pre-screen only (every source); a title with a prefilterExcludeOverrides phrase is exempt from the manager and level-suffix exclusions only.

githubLists.listsNote: Community posting lists read from each repository's raw README (public repositories, no token). Switch one off with enabled: false; url overrides the README location.

hackerNewsHiring.note: The monthly Ask HN: Who is hiring? thread through the public Algolia HN Search API; only posts that mention intern, new grad, entry level, or junior are kept.

remoteOk.note: RemoteOK's public JSON feed; only remote postings open to the United States with an early-career title or tag are kept, and each card links back to the posting on remoteok.com as its terms ask.

searchDiscovery.note: Web search for full-time entry-level postings (past day, United States) through Brave or Tavily. The key lives in private/search.json: { "brave": "<key>" } or { "tavily": { "apiKey": "<key>" } }; without one nothing runs (one info line). Every query counts against monthlyQueryCap (state/search-usage.json, by local month) and the collector stops at the cap so a free tier is never exceeded. queries overrides the built-in pool; each run takes queriesPerRun consecutive queries starting at the day of the year. Results on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, or SmartRecruiters register that board; other pages are candidates that go through the prefilter.

atsBoards.boardsNote: Boards are discovered from posting URLs automatically and kept in state/ats-boards.json; list one here to add it by hand or to switch it off. key forms: greenhouse:<token>, lever:<company>, ashby:<org>, workday:<tenant>/<site>@<tenant>.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com; url accepts a board front page or any posting on it.
atsBoards.seedsNote: Company boards to add by hand. A seed is registered once (origin seed) and then follows the same baseline, quiet (weekly polls after 30 days without new postings), and dormant (7 failures) rules as a discovered board; unlike boards it never switches a board back on. Forms: { greenhouse: <token> }, { lever: <company> }, { ashby: <org> }, { smartrecruiters: <company> }, { workday: <tenant>/<site>, host: <tenant>.wdN.myworkdayjobs.com } (the host is required), a key string such as greenhouse:examplecorp, or a board URL; company is an optional label.

network.userAgent: DailyJobMatchAlert/0.1 (+personal job search; respectful daily polling)
